title: Who Will Witness the End?
statement: Given n labeled integers placed around a circle, the weight of an arrangement is the product over each pair of neighbours of their sum; two arrangements are the same only when one is a rotation of the other, and reflections count as distinct. The task is to add the weights of all distinct circular arrangements modulo 998244353, for n up to 200000, so the factorially many arrangements cannot be enumerated.
